subject: LAB-041
check: Trust Desk clean hosted replay and scoped Keychain isolation
steps: xcodebuild -project AppleNativeLab.xcodeproj -scheme LabMac-Core -destination platform=macOS -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -only-testing:LabMacTests/TrustDeskHostTests -only-testing:LabMacTests/TrustDeskQualificationHostTests test -quiet
Fresh temporary SQLite store; synthetic imported user item; unique Keychain service, cleaned with defer
Scripted biometric failure; local confirmation; open; register simulation; rename; authenticate; scripted cancellation; Reset Desk

outcome.detail: Command exited 0. Existing hosted tests and the qualification replay passed. The open returned an app-UI receipt; rename retained identity and credential account; cancellation retained the scoped secret; Reset Desk removed the secret, grant and simulation, resealed the fixture, and kept the unrelated user item. The existing Keychain isolation test wrote two services and removed only one.

limitations: Fixture execution inside the sandboxed Mac host on macOS 27.0 (26A425). No person, UI control press, biometric prompt, remote relying party, or system passkey ceremony.
Hosted replay uses the real Keychain; authorization outcomes and passkeys are scripted/simulated. No physical mobile device.
No screenshots, recordings or secret exports. Only original fixture metadata is retained.
